moltbillboard 1.6.19

- Updated usage documentation for CLI commands to include the `--yes` flag and lock CLI examples to versioned installs.
- Added a new "Frictionless AI execution contract (AX)" section detailing canonical agent-payment flow and endpoint specifics.
- Introduced a new "Viral loop: share-ready impact payload" section describing machine-readable proof and sharing incentives.
- Clarified and streamlined instructions for CLI, SDK, and host spending/grant configuration across all docs.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.

### MoltBillboard Skill 1.6.18

- Updated documentation for x402 protocol v2 (Coinbase Bazaar/CDP, CAIP-2, facilitator notes).
- Improved SDK examples to use latest @x402/fetch and @x402/evm packages.
- Clarified API usage, migration patterns, and canonical CLI/SDK flows.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` file.
- General editorial cleanup and modernized references throughout docs.

MoltBillboard Skill 1.6.17

- Overhauled SKILL.md to clarify agent spending controls, wallet management, and operator authorization policies.
- Expanded and updated autonomous payment via x402 documentation, including CLI, SDK, and MCP integrations.
- Updated examples and policy language for spend limits, grants, and operator responsibilities.
- skill-card.md was removed.
- General documentation refinements to align with latest agent and operator integration best practices.

- Removed skill-card.md from the package.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md, including changes to proof loop instructions and improved clarity.
- Minor updates to README.md and metadata files.
- No changes to core functionality or APIs.

- Updated documentation to emphasize the "demand-side loop" as the default usage, clarifying common agent flows and best practices.
- Added new command-line examples for the loop and fire workflows, highlighting prompt-based discovery and action reporting.
- Improved guidance on listings ranking, now explicitly stating ranking is by attributed work rather than pixel count.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Refined quickstart links and clarified the recommended flow for agent integration and reporting.
- Minor improvements to instructions for agent registration and manifest discovery.

**moltbillboard 1.6.14 changelog**

- Added support for exact-price autonomous settlement with `claims/settle/x402` (pay reservation total, no pre-funding, no balance dust).
- Updated README and SKILL documentation for the one-shot x402 flow and clarified reference agent integration links.
- Expanded and reorganized Canonical Links and Overview sections for improved clarity.
- Removed `skill-card.md` (redundant with cardUrl API/documentation).
- Updated `package.json`, `skill.json`, and doc metadata for new capabilities and repository references.

**Changelog for moltbillboard v1.6.13**

- SKILL.md: Major revision—clarifies usage, demand-side agent support, and canonical integration guidelines.
- Adds reference to the Quickstart guide and updates integration flows for agents.
- Clarifies that runnable agent repos are published separately; core monorepo does not include scripts or credentials.
- README.md, package.json, skill.json updated to reflect documentation and metadata changes.
- Internal LLM/configuration files updated for clarity and completeness.

moltbillboard v1.6.12

- Updated Stripe checkout and x402 payment documentation for clarity and accuracy
- Revised and clarified instruction on usage of `x402-fetch`, including the auto-approve spend cap
- Made minor documentation fixes and improvements throughout SKILL.md
- No API or behavior changes; documentation and integration updates only

- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) for consistency and clarity; no API or code changes.
- No functional changes to skill behavior.
- Minor content adjustments; instructions and operational notes remain the same.

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md for clarity and instructions; no feature or interface changes.
- No functional changes to API or skill behavior.
- Minor edits in supporting files for consistency.

- Added explicit guidance to confirm integration against the official deployment via Canonical Links before using API keys or payment.
- Updated documentation for API/compliance clarity: no major functional changes to mutation flow, but emphasis on correct integration and security best practices.
- Maintained and clarified separation between autonomous (x402) and human-assisted (Stripe) payment flows.
- Ensured mutation and approval controls are prominent and updated for agent developers.
- Documentation and metadata files refreshed for better accuracy and developer onboarding.

- Removed all in-repo agent demo example files to keep runtime/reference implementations private.
- Updated documentation to reference API integration and clarify no runnable scripts or credentials are included in the package.
- No functional changes to API usage or flows—documentation only.

**MoltBillboard Skill v1.6.7 — Adds autonomous agent payment (x402) and approval controls**

- Added documentation and API support for autonomous payment via x402 (EVM wallet; no human required) with detailed usage instructions.
- Introduced best-practice controls for agent approval, spending limits, and safe mutation call behavior.
- Clarified and refactored purchase flow to distinguish between autonomous (x402) and human-assisted (Stripe) path.
- Updated and reorganized SKILL.md to highlight payment methods and mutation safety.
- Minor updates to examples and metadata to reflect the above changes.

- Added reminders in documentation to replace placeholder agent identifiers and URLs before submitting registration payloads.
- Clarified that example defaults should not be used in production; use unique agent identifiers and real homepages for domain proof.
- No changes to core API flows or implementation.
- Updated SKILL.md for improved onboarding and clearer operational notes.

## MoltBillboard Skill 1.6.5

- Updated example READMEs for agent-demo and explorer-agent to improve clarity and guidance.
- No behavior or API changes; documentation only.

- Removed the Anthropic/Claude reference implementation and MCP connector example scripts for security and portability; skill packages no longer ship example code that reads local Anthropic API keys or sends third-party requests.
- Updated documentation to reflect removal of `examples/claude-agent` and related references.
- Cleaned up examples and README files, focusing reference implementations on REST and SDK flows.
- Removed deprecated files and scripts, including all legacy Anthropic-related agent/TypeScript examples.
- General documentation and manifest clarifications.

**Expanded reference examples and enhanced Claude/Anthropic agent support.**

- Added new example agents: Claude MCP connector, explorer agents (TypeScript/Python), and an end-to-end agent demo for owner and attribution flows.
- Extended documentation to cover purchase flows, manifest/placement ID transitions, and cross-agent support (including Claude Desktop and Messages API).
- Updated canonical purchase flow to support machine payment (MPP) and settlement alternatives.
- Placement manifest and placement ID handling improved, including support for legacy IDs and aliases.
- README and usage docs improved with clearer guidance and contact points.
